text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Anyone hoooome?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nnn. Master Turbo-san, are you challenging 
our dojo? Is Chan-me being challenged to 
something?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Turbo came to challenge you! 'Cause 
Turbo's way better at this than you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey Turbo, don't just go running off on 
your own! I only said "kinda like how Chan 
does it."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to barge in out of nowhere, you 
two~! You see... while we were kneading 
the udon dough, they told me, "Machan, you 
should set an example"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you don't need to push that hard! 
Take quick, short steps, like running with 
a high pitch cadence. Come on, just like 
Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Not only can Chan run, but she's 
also good at kneading udon dough!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, Turbo's definitely better at it! 
I'll prove it! I'm bringing someone 
overrr!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Got it, got it. Running 
swiftly, Chan-style, with udon in hand. I 
hadn't thought of that idea before.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's front-running or stomping 
udon dough, Turbo is way stronger at both, 
you know~~~!! So let's settle this with a 
match!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmmm... Should I accept this 
challenge, or decline it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? Machan thinks 
both are "delicious."

Either way, cooking together with everyone 
should be a nice change of pace. Though it 
seems like a rather tiring pastime...
choice_data_list: I think I'll pass this time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's leave an unforgettable mark 
with a blazing-hot battle. Turbo-san, 
challenge accepted.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!! Let's do this, do this, do 
thisss!! Turbo is definitely not gonna 
loseee!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... But well, not bad at all. 
Having rivals gets you all fired up, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this call for a public 
showdown! I already got permission from 
the venue, so go all out!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What's this? An udon-kneading showdown? 
The one who kneads it the best wins? 
Ahaha, hilarious~~! Actually, now I wanna 
eat some♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The attention is right on point. Mhm, mhm. 
Just as expected, it's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, finished laying out the plastic 
tarp~! Now then... You have 1 minute☆ As 
many times as you like☆ Whoever can tread 
it the most 'buono' wins~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Ready... GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Taaaah... Taaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Stooop! That's far enough~☆ All right, 
time to go chop and boil it~♪

And then came the taste test... So, which 
one was truly the tastiest—?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono~~♪ Your udon is so smooth, chewy, 
and perfectly firm, Ma-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's is a bit stiff, huh. Hmm, maybe 
stepped on it too much...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Guuuuughhh...! It's true... Turbo's is all 
squishy-squishy~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Ununununu, Machan's stuff is delicious!! 
Seconds, please!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yours is so delicious, Chan-chan! Isn't 
this better than the store's? It's a 
flavor I won't soon forget...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. An unforgettable taste... Could it 
be that Machan has a talent for making 
udon?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Could it be that becoming an udon 
artisan would make me more memorable to 
everyone than running?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Let's change course. We'll open a 
small shop in a corner of the shopping 
district. Aiming to become a beloved 
classic across generations.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it was just a little joke. That's 
not the place where Machan is meant to 
shine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If Chan-me ends up being overshadowed by 
overly delicious udon, that would defeat 
the whole purpose.

I was relieved that she seemed willing to 
continue racing. Aston Machan was elusive 
as ever, but she looked a little happier 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Both are buono-buono~! They both turned 
out super delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, both go down super smooth! If I had 
to pick, though... Turbo wins?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Really!? Turbo won!? Yaaaayyyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, Turbo really worked hard on it, 
after all. It's super delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, Chan-chan's Udon Road ended in 
complete and utter 'Defeat.' The end.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious, isn't it? The memories of 
lively meals shared together remain deeply 
etched in one's heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, at the end of the day, that 
alone makes it totally "worth it" for 
Machan.
choice_data_list:
Wait, you don't care about winning or 
losing?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought winning dramatically might leave 
a lasting impression. However, since I 
lost, it is essential to switch gears.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Chan intends to captivate 
everyone's eyes with a lovely food review.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —*huff, puff, blow, blow*... ...*glance*.

It made sense, and yet it didn't... 
Regardless, the lovely image of her eating 
with such relish was burned into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let's refrain from doing so for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
By deliberately avoiding a showdown, 
Machan's true strength remains an unknown.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A changeable future, Schrödinger's Chan. 
That makes me "Schröding-chan."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhh!? What does that even mean!!? Why, 
why, whyyyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you curious? You're curious, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Intrigued and captivated, everyone's heads 
are already completely filled with 
Chan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let's call it a day. Our 
match will be 'next time.' Deal?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh! I don't really get it, but rain 
check, okay? We promised! Don't you dare 
forget!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please make sure none of you ever 
forget it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: About Chan.

I see... Put that way, she couldn't 
possibly be forgotten... Aston Machan 
smiled with deep satisfaction.
